sloka: आचम्य च यथाशास्त्रम् नदीम् ताम् सह सीतया ।प्राणमत्प्रीतिसम्हृष्टो लक्ष्मणश्चामितप्रभः ॥२-५२-७९॥
transliteration: ācamya ca yathāśāstram nadīm tām saha sītayā ।prāṇamatprītisamhṛṣṭo lakṣmaṇaścāmitaprabhaḥ ॥2-52-79॥

translations.english: Rama of undimmed radiance sipped the waters (of the Ganga) in accordance with the scriptures and with great pleasure and paid obeisance to the river with Sita and Lakshmana.
